audit.why: Headbutt/Pulverize sit at 14s early, 10s at rank 5; Unbreakable Will is 120/100/80s. Naming the real numbers lets a reader time the window instead of just being told 'it's up'.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart (phases[0-3].side=Alistar, phases[4-6].side=Skill) is inverted against both the content layer (win[0-3]=Skill, win[4-6]=Alistar) and the packet's levelChart, which itself flags the contradiction (defects[0]).
audit.why: Content already matches the packet: even early (Q outranges his short engage before level 6), Alistar favored once Unbreakable Will (R) makes his engage unpeelable and his first item lets him roam-dive. The full layer's side column was simply backwards.
audit.corrected: Flipped phases[0-3].side to Skill and phases[4-6].side to Alistar, matching content win[] and the packet; rewrote each .why to state the correct side without contradicting itself.

edits.before: Starcall the contacts — the self-heal funds the bank and the slow annoys their spacing.
edits.after: Level 1 is even: Starcall pokes his contacts while his short range can't reach you yet.

edits.before: W opens the battery: your carry's HP bar is now a shared account.
edits.after: Coin-flip: his W-Q all-in trades against your heal-and-poke rhythm.

edits.before: Equinox threats begin: the silence zone cancels engages mid-cast.
edits.after: Skill-based level: you sustain his chip while he hunts for a Pulverize.

edits.before: Heal the margins and Q the refills — the battery economy runs the lane.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 remain even while both sides scale toward the level 6 power spike.

edits.before: Wish online — every all-in on the map gets a second health bar.
edits.after: At 6, Unbreakable Will makes his engage unpeelable, tilting his way.

edits.before: First item: the heals compound and the silence zones decide dives.
edits.after: First item and roams: his dive threat starts to outweigh your healing.

edits.before: Late Soraka is the global bank: wish the map, silence the dives, and outlast every ledger.
edits.after: Late, his uncleansable engage and flips force you to react, which now favors him each fight.

edits.before: Q the refill, W the carry, repeat — the battery economy runs while their math wonders why nothing dies.
edits.after: Cast Astral Infusion (W) outside Headbutt's 650 range so healing never invites his knockback.

edits.before: Healing into a full rotation with the bank empty — Soraka without Q refills is a donation with a horn.
edits.after: At half HP you're one Headbutt-Pulverize combo from dying — disengage and rebuild the bank first.

edits.before: - Alistar Headbutt: matchup-defining — The headbutt-pulverize combo starts every play — respect flash range while it is up. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Equinox banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Headbutt (W) and Pulverize (Q) sit at 14s early, 10s at rank 5 — the combo starts every play, track it. - Trample (E) stuns off an auto-reset; the wind-up is your cue to step back, not the cast. - Unbreakable Will (R) is 120/100/80s, a fight call not a habit.

edits.before: Good trade: Q the refill, W the carry, repeat — the battery economy runs while their math wonders why nothing dies. Bad trade: Healing into a full rotation with the bank empty — Soraka without Q refills is a donation with a horn.
edits.after: Good trade: chip him with Starcall (Q) and bank the refill — Triumphant Roar heals his chip back, so grab anti-heal before extending. Bad trade: healing a full rotation with the bank empty invites the Headbutt-Pulverize combo.
